Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your Digimon. Then, gain 1 memory for each suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of their traits you have in play. If you gain 2 or more memory by this effect, unsuspend this Digimon and it gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.[Your Turn] For every 2 suspended Digimon you have in play, this Digimon gets +2000 DP and gains ＜Security Attack +1＞.
